name: browser-use
headline: paper-craft-skills: Papers to Figures & Slides
short_description: Turn academic papers into publication-ready method figures, visual slide decks, and deep-dive articles using AI-powered analysis and generation—no configuration required.
author: zsyggg

sections.overview:
paper-craft-skills automates the conversion of academic papers into three polished outputs: method figures (paper-comic), visual slide decks (paper-deck), and in-depth articles (paper-analyzer). The skill reads full papers, searches GitHub for implementations, and generates publication-grade visuals and HTML articles with formula rendering and code cross-reference. It works with arXiv links or local PDFs, requires zero API keys, and offers multiple styles—from journal-minimal to sketchnote—letting researchers, students, and technical teams transform papers into shareable, presentation-ready formats in seconds.
Generate publication-grade method figures and architecture diagrams from papers
Create visual slide decks for thesis defenses and research presentations
Write deep-dive technical articles with formula breakdowns and code alignment
Convert papers into approachable study notes with sketchnote illustrations
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/zsyggg/paper-craft-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the following academic paper on [TOPIC] and provide a detailed summary. Focus on the methodology, key findings, and implications for [INDUSTRY]. Use bullet points and clear headings. Then, create a one-page comic strip summarizing the paper's main points in a visually engaging way. Use simple text and stick-figure style illustrations.
```
